presentation.name: Mentat
presentation.subtitle: Human in command
presentation.revision: The Drummer front door, measured and refined: it says who is speaking, how old its record is, and reads in high contrast.

statement: V44 Mentat refines the Drummer front door, a live transit gate and seven stations in the platinum cAshIo identity, after a rendered nine category review. The gate is generative artwork. The helm and E.V.E. are scripted browser experiences that send no requests. Observation records and historical releases retain their original dates, versions and limits.
